rows.en: Touya: "Whoa... Did we get through...?! Where's everyone..."
Touya: "We can't go back... So we're on our own from here..."
Melissa: "I sense a deliberate will behind this."
Yamato: "You mean someone set this up?"
Melissa: "It's just a feeling.
But if we can't go back, we have to go forward."
Touya: "Yeah, you're right.
...All right, let's go."
Melissa: "Huh... Is this the 'Core'...?"
Yamato: "It's absurdly huge..."
Voice: (Welcome to my castle.)
Touya: "?! What the... Straight into my head..."
Melissa: "What's wrong?"
Touya: "You can't hear it?"
Melissa: "No. I can't hear anything..."
Touya: "I see...
Someone is speaking directly into my head right now."
Melissa: "...Directly?"
Voice: (At last, someone has reached this place...)
Touya: (...Who the hell are you?)
Voice: (Ah, of course... What about this?
Doesn't the voice sound familiar now?)
Touya: (That's... Debish!?
You're still alive?!)
Voice: (Hahahahaha!)
Touya: (What's so funny?!)
Voice: (...No, pardon me.
Your thinking was simply so hasty.
It's true that I once lived within him, but I am not him.
Let's see... You may think of me
as a being like that Lin Karma person
who accompanied you.)
Touya: (Disembodied consciousness that can exist even without its body...)
Voice: (I am something purer and more essential, though.
In any case, you have done well.
I never imagined that failure back then would produce this result.)
Touya: (Back then... Don't tell me, 109 years ago...)
Voice: (Correct. I expected it to go well...
But it brought forth someone as gifted as you,
so perhaps it was not a mistake in the end.
They too worked well for me.
Debish, Lyle, Bernst... And Sharl.
They all devoted themselves to me...)
Touya: (What exactly do you want?)
Voice: (...You humans of the Solar System were truly
amusing creatures.
You can sacrifice your own kind without hesitation
for your desires, yet also try to save them...
It is most intriguing.
I never tire of watching your behavior.
What was the word...? Ah,
in your world, do you call it 'entertainment'?)
Touya: ('Entertainment'... You say...?)
Voice: (Yes, entertainment.
The way you struggle and suffer... And still defy me.
Nothing beats the excitement
of a true fight with lives at stake... Hehehehe.)
Touya: (Why would you do that?!)
Voice: (Why? What an amusing question.
Because I'm bored, naturally.
For those of us freed from the shackles of time,
able even to create the future,
everyday life is nothing but tedium.
That is why chosen beings like myself
indulge in games like this to pass the time.
Yes, risking the loss of our own existence.)
Touya: (You're bored...? You bastard...
For something like that...!!)
Voice: (...Have you ever merely existed
in the aimless flow of time?
Nothing changes. The same time simply passes...
I too believed that was natural at first.
I never even questioned it. But it was not.
When I observed humans on distant worlds
far beyond our galaxy, living their fleeting lives,
they brought a time of fulfillment to my empty heart.
They risked their lives, fought, and won, showing me
the brilliance of life. The excitement I felt
was understood by only a very few.
But that does not matter.
I am living a fulfilling existence now.)
Touya: (I'll never forgive you... Playing with people's lives
to entertain yourself... I'll never forgive you!!)
Voice: (Good, yes. Come at me like that.
Humanity's future is in your hands now.
Or in that Rayblade you pilot, rather.)
Touya: (What do you mean?)
Voice: (Throughout recorded history, whenever humanity was in danger,
there was something to stop it, wasn't there?
Sometimes a person, sometimes a sword,
and sometimes an idea...
Something appropriate to the age saved humanity.
Have you never found it strange
that such convenient things happen?)
Touya: (D-don't tell me...)
Voice: (Yes, it was me. Those fools of Lin Karma
seem to have thought they sealed Vorlia away.
But I could leave such a place whenever I wanted.
I stayed simply because there was no need to leave.
Above all, it kept them from interfering.
It was convenient for playing with you humans,
who only mend the surface and never learn anything fundamental.
...And this time, that Rayblade is
humanity's 'key' to salvation.
The only thing capable of stopping this Vorlia.
That is why you could reach me here...)
Touya: (...But if we're alive now,
doesn't that mean you lost before?)
Voice: (No. They failed. They could not even
reach me... So all of them sank into history,
their goals unfulfilled...)
Touya: (...Then I'll end it this time.)
Voice: (Hehehe... Yes. A wager should be made
on equal terms. Keeping myself somewhere safe
would prevent me from enjoying it truly.
You might call it suspense.
It multiplies the pleasure many times over.
That is why I have given you a chance.)
Touya: (...)
Voice: (If you use Rayblade to destroy this 'Core,'
Vorlia and I will be unable to sustain our existence, and will vanish.
Then this world will be saved...
Hehehe... Now, may I begin?)
Touya: "..."
Melissa: "...Is that what they call telepathy?"
Touya: "..."
Melissa: "Touya...?"
Touya: "...Huh? What?"
Melissa: "What's wrong? You're spacing out..."
Touya: "? I was... talking just now..."
Melissa: "Talking...? In these few seconds?"
Touya: "...A few seconds...? I see..."
Voice: (Surprised? I can do things like this too.)
Touya: (...You're one hell of a monster...)
Voice: (Hehehehe... Well then, shall we begin...?)
Yamato: "M-meow, what's that?!"
Melissa: "Rayblade...?"
Touya: "...Let's go."
Melissa: "Huh?"
Touya: "If we beat it, everything will be over."
Melissa: "I don't understand, but I'm sure you're right.
Yes. All right."
Touya: "Sorry."
Melissa: "I like a man who's a little forceful.
You're rather appealing right now, Touya."
Voice: (...Hm? You're damaged...
It won't be interesting unless you fight
in perfect condition... Very well.)
Melissa: "What?! The damage... It's repaired..."
Touya: "..."
Voice: (Now, entertain me!)
Touya: (Let's end this.)
Voice: (Heh... Hehehehehe... Very well.
Then end it all with your own hands...)
Touya: (I don't need you to tell me!)
Voice: (Good. You're proving quite entertaining...
But it seems this is as far as you go...
Well, this time some excellent pawns
have made things quite enjoyable... But
it is time to say farewell...)
Voice: (...You have disappointed me...
You were doing so well until now...
Still, this time some excellent pawns
have made things quite enjoyable... So
I'll erase you instantly, without suffering...)
Touya: "Damn... You bastard..."
Melissa: "Touya..."
Voice: (What?! I-impossible... You...!)
Kasumi: "Touya! Melissa! Yamato!
Are you all right?!"
Touya: "Kasumi!"
Clovis: "Hey, looks like you're having a rough time."
Arthur: "Isn't it unfair
for you to keep all the glory to yourselves?"
Melvi: "Wow! Touya, everyone's come!"
Aurelie: "We managed to get here in time."
Fain: "With us here, you can rest easy!"
Xiujian: "...Heh."
Melissa: "It really is better when we're all together."
Celica: "This is how a finale should be!"
Gen: "I'll make a cool showing for the finale too!"
Voice: (Why... How could you breach that barrier...?)
Rayfon: (You shouldn't underestimate the people of this world.
These humans who have established their 'individuality.'
Each alone is weak. But when they join together,
they show greater strength than you expect...
That is what sets these humans apart.
Because they are imperfect, they try to make up for it
by cooperating with others. That creates
an unpredictable power that numbers cannot explain.
Trust, friendship, love... It takes many forms.
Do you know its name?)
Voice: (...)
Rayfon: (Its name... is 'bonds.'
You believe only in yourselves, trusting nobody.
No one relies on you, and you love nobody.
I doubt you could understand.)
Voice: (Hehehehe... Hahahahaha!
Fascinating. More fascinating by the moment!
Very well! I grant you all the right
to participate in this wager!)
Voice: (...!? Why?! Why won't they come forth?!)
Rishuna: (It's no use. I've sealed off this space.
You can no longer summon anything.)
Voice: (Damn...)
Valga: (It's about time we ended this.)
Voice: (It seems... I underestimated you somewhat...
But I can also do this...)
Clovis: "What?! What's going on...?"
Arthur: "Illusions...? No, that's not it..."
Xiujian: "...So our final foe is ourselves..."
Voice: (Now, let the delightful festivities begin!!)
Touya: "Our target is that black one. Beating it should be enough."
Melissa: "All right. But don't rush."
Touya: "Yeah, I know."
Melissa: "Do you? Would you like me to work
my special little charm on you?"
Touya: "...I'll pass."
Melissa: "...How dull.
But I do like that shy side of you too. Yes."
Touya: "...Say what you like."
Melissa: "...It's all right. Don't be nervous.
The man I fell in love with isn't that weak.
So stay calm. I'll be with you the whole time."
Touya: "Yeah... You're right.
I've got you with me..."
Clovis: "Th-this is..."
Fain: "Oh!"
Celica: "I can't believe it..."
Touya: "...Here we go!!"
Melissa: "Everyone!"
Kasumi: "Touya!"
Clovis: "Are you both all right?!"
Touya: "Yeah..."
Xiujian: "...The battle appears to be decided."
Yamato: "...I'm here too, you know..."
Melissa: "Now, now..."
Voice: (...Splendid... You have given me great enjoyment...)
Touya: (This is the end.)
Voice: (Hehehehehe... Yes...
But that doesn't mean everything is over...)
Touya: (...What do you mean...?)
Voice: (I will disappear, certainly.
But unless you make the Core cease to exist,
you cannot stop Vorlia...)
Touya: (What?!)
Voice: (...It was enjoyable...
Experiencing destruction isn't so bad... after all...)
Touya: (W-wait! How do I make the Core disappear?!)
Voice: (...I told you Rayblade was the key...
You'll have to figure out what to do yourself...)
Touya: (The key... Myself...)
Voice: (...Hehehehe... It's a pity I cannot
see the ending, but I wish you luck... Farewell...)
Touya: "..."
Melissa: "...Touya?"
Touya: "O-oh... Sorry."
Melissa: "...What's wrong?
Were you talking to someone again?"
Touya: "Melissa..."
Melissa: "What is it?"
Touya: "I'm sorry."
Melissa: "...Why are you apologizing?"
Melissa: "Huh? Wh-what...?"
Yamato: "Is Vorlia moving?
What in the meow...?"
Touya: "...Tch. It won't even give me time to think..."
Melissa: "..."
Touya: "...Hear me out."
Yamato: "Huh? Why are you switching to transmit mode?
Hey. Hey, Tou..."
Melissa: "..."
Yamato: "Huh? Why are you stopping me, meow...?"
Melissa: "...Let's leave it to Touya.
Let's trust him and follow him, okay?"
Yamato: "O-okay..."
Touya: "...I'm going to destroy Vorlia's Core.
But only this Rayblade can do it.
So I want you to return ahead of us."
Fain: "Hey! What the hell do you mean?!"
Touya: "...I know I'm being selfish
saying this after we've come so far.
But it isn't because I don't believe in you.
I want you to go back because I believe in you, because I trust you.
Let me feel safe knowing I have a place to come back to,
a place I have to come back to..."
Clovis: "Hey, you can't say that after we've come this far.
We're sticking with you to the end."
Xiujian: "Heh... Do you think we'll obediently return
just because you ask? I haven't sunk so low
that I'd dump the burden on a comrade and walk away alone."
Arthur: "How cold... I'll accompany you to the end."
Fain: "What are you saying?! I'll stay with you to the end too!"
Rayfon: "We should accept the facts calmly.
There's nothing we can do as we are now.
It's frustrating... But it's the truth.
We should not make this harder for him.
If we really believe in him, if we really are his comrades,
we should leave this to him."
Rayfon: "...But you must keep
your promise to return."
Touya: "...Yeah. I'll try."
Clovis: "Touya... No, never mind.
It's only a brief parting."
Touya: "...I'm counting on you to handle things back there."
Clovis: "Yeah. Don't die!"
Xiujian: "......I won't say farewell."
Touya: "Yeah... I'm counting on you to handle things back there."
Xiujian: "...Understood."
Arthur: "...I won't say goodbye."
Touya: "Yeah. Neither will I."
Arthur: "...Be careful..."
Fain: "......Damn!"
Touya: "I'm counting on you to handle things back there."
Fain: "...A-all right! But don't you dare die!
That's a promise!"
Touya: "Yeah..."
Kasumi: "Touya... I'll be waiting.
So I won't say goodbye..."
Touya: "Yeah. Just wait a little while."
Kasumi: "Okay. I understand...... Be safe."
Touya: "...I'll be going."
Touya: "...Well then, let's go."
Yamato: "Go...?"
Melissa: "...You're going to use Rayblade itself."
Touya: "Yeah..."
Melissa: "That's the only way?"
Touya: "...I'm sorry."
Melissa: "Honestly... Why are you apologizing?!"
Touya: "Melissa...?"
Melissa: "I don't have any regrets, you know.
I'm proud I fell in love with you.
So don't apologize.
I'll go with you, no matter how far...
So don't say that... Please."
Touya: "...Sorry."
Melissa: "There you go again..."
Touya: "S-sor... Oh."
Melissa: "Honestly! But I love that side of you too,
all of you..."
Touya: "Melissa..."
Melissa: "...Hey, Touya."
Touya: "Hm?"
Melissa: "Can I... come over there?"
Touya: "Huh? But what about piloting...?"
Melissa: "It's all right. We aren't fighting now, and even if
I do nothing, it should move properly.
This mech has taken in so many of our feelings..."
Touya: "...You're right... Wait, do people usually come over before I answer?"
Melissa: "What's wrong with that?
...There we go. It's a little cramped."
Touya: "Of course it is."
Melissa: "But this is where I feel closest to you.
Now I'm not scared..."
Touya: "..."
Melissa: "You keep apologizing, don't you?"
Touya: "Sorry..."
Melissa: "See?"
Touya: "Oh..."
Melissa: "Hehehehe."
Touya: "...Shall we go...?"
Melissa: "...Okay."
Touya: "Uooooooooh!!"

review_batches.context: Read all363 rows and complete Melvi/Ymir variants, with earlier finales for context. Melissa suspects orchestration but qualifies it as a feeling; concealed Voice reaches only Touya, borrows Debish's voice and describes past failures/entertainment.

No narrator confirmation of orchestration, occupant name or named Lin Karma companion. Preserve109-year reference, short-circuit-thinking insult and attributed cosmic claims. Do not generalize the speaker's plural we to every alien having the same pastime.
